method.current_listing: Fresh Sellers participations and exhaustive getReports DONE V2 listings under all five configured credential scopes, with no marketplace filter; active-marketplace filtered discovery independently returned the same report identities.
method.content_snapshots: All 94 current report/document identities and available report metadata match retained September 7 snapshots. 49 documents were re-downloaded September 8 and byte-identical; 45 EU bodies were reused from matched prior raw copies.
method.raw_cache_integrity_limits: NA acquisition hashes were retained. EU/FE original per-body digests were not retained; EU complete prior parsed-cell snapshots and FE retained fields were crosschecked. All FE documents and 21 EU documents were re-downloaded today. Immutability of the remaining 45 EU bodies is not established independently.
method.retained_dates: The original FE cache lacked API dataStartTime/dataEndTime. No TSV dates were substituted for those missing API metadata fields.
method.historical_extension: 27 older NA/EU archived API downloads supported by retained acquisition logs; no original byte digests. 23 pass the existing structural parser. Four are diagnostic-only because 15 rows lack the final promotion-id cell.
method.row_selection: Every content row of each complete strict-parser document, including zero amounts, blank marketplace names, and out-of-header-period postings. Header and metadata row excluded. No business validation filters the sample.
method.classification: Match F1-F7 before validating known-family fields and SKU expectations. Other rows retain raw SKU and remain a separate audit population; this is source evidence, not an Amazon guarantee.
method.identity: Deduplicate exact decoded bodies with matching credential scope and TSV settlement ID. Differing bodies for one scoped identity are not silently merged; none observed.
method.marketplace: Observed marketplace-name rows are counted separately from scope/currency and API metadata. Currency or a query filter never fills blank row marketplaces.
method.retrocharges: Candidate groups use credential scope, currency, exact retrocharge transaction type, order ID, available adjustment ID, and normalized posting timestamp. Zero net is checked; it is not independent proof of complete event identity/coverage.
method.scope_of_conclusion: Checks SKU presence and family invariants, not SKU correctness/ownership, Data Kiosk completeness or exclusions, or full preprocessing/payout readiness.
